'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Eric White DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Eric White]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Heavy Metal Jabba Love'''. Transcription notes: Line 15 written ''Mara Jade with Vibe''; Line 17 written ''Jabba's Pimp Wagon for Space''; Line 18 written ''Jabba's Pimp Wagon for Ground''; Line 58 written ''Anger, Fear, Aggression'' (Anger, Fear, Aggression is a Light Side card; left unlinked on this Dark list). Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]]
* '''Username:''' TheDigitalJawa
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
